description: Seznam javno dostopnih WiFi točk v Občini Trebnje is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA TREBNJE. List of publicly accessible WiFi points in the Municipality of Trebnje. The collection contains the name of the point, the location coordinate, the speed and the provider. Coverage: OBČINA TREBNJE. The portal shows the English title as "List of publicly accessible WiFi points in the Municipality of Trebnje" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA TREBNJE. Its keywords include Wi-Fi, dostopne točke. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XLSX, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
